turns.prompt: lets tweak the maze chomp animation. add one more frame in between each frame transition to make it smoother.  at the current tileset, 7 frames per tick would be a good speed
turns.reply:
I added an in-between after each chomp frame, so the maze chomp now has 7 frames and plays 0…6 and back. Each frame is held for 7 game frames. The arcade test passes and a maze screenshot showed no console errors. PR: https://github.com/fischerq/ludumdare60/pull/58

- **Art:** Max's four frames are now `pac-0`, `pac-2`, `pac-4` and `pac-6`. The new `pac-1`, `pac-3` and `pac-5` are rough placeholders I generated by blending the shapes of the frames either side, in his colours and outline. `pac-5` comes out lemon-shaped, so Max will probably want to redraw all three. He can save his versions over the files and the export won't overwrite them.
- **Speed:** I read "7 frames per tick" as the lab's setting (game frames each animation frame is shown) and set Pac to 7. One full chomp now takes 12 steps instead of 6. So it's about 7× slower than the old setting of 2, and also twice as slow as 7 would have been with the old 4 frames. If it feels sluggish, 3–4 gives the speed that 7 gave before. It's a one-line change in the lab or `animation.json`.
- **Start screen:** I halved the menu Pac's setting from 6 to 3 so its chomp runs at the same speed as before.

**To test on the phone:** play the maze and check whether the chomp looks smoother and whether 7 is the speed you wanted.
